name: Battery Recovery
focus: Common words and short sentences. Builds basic accuracy.
malfunction: Power cells drained. Spark cannot hold a charge.

passages: charge the cell and check the light. the robot is ready to go home.
plug in the power line and wait for the green glow on the panel.
open the case, clean the pins and close the lid with care.
Spark needs a full charge before the next delivery run. Check each cell and reset the meter.
The battery is warm but stable. Lower the current and let the cells rest for a moment.
Turn the main switch off, swap the old cell for a new one, then turn the power back on.
Balance all four cells, raise the charge rate slowly, and watch the heat sensor until it settles.
Spark will carry medicine across the city tonight, so the battery must last for every single stop.

name: Circuit Restoration
focus: Longer sentences and tricky letter combinations.
malfunction: Burnt traces on the motion board. Volta twitches at random.

passages: Reconnect the motion board through the auxiliary junction and strengthen the weakened connection.
The instruction set requires precise calibration before the mechanical arm can function again.
Throughput dropped when the thermal threshold was crossed, so the controller throttled each actuator.
Straighten the bent connector, then synchronise the encoder with the movement it is supposed to measure.
Electromagnetic interference was misinterpreted as legitimate instruction, triggering involuntary oscillation.
Recalculate the acknowledgement thresholds; the transmission subsystem keeps misjudging each synchronisation pulse.

name: Communication Override
focus: Long passages. Endurance and sustained accuracy.
malfunction: Signal relay jammed by The Glitch. Nova has lost contact with the fleet.

passages: This is the repair facility calling every unit on the eastern route. The signal tower is back online and the relay is clear. Please confirm your position, report any damage, and wait for further instructions before you move again.

Attention, transport fleet. The Glitch corrupted your routing tables at dawn, which is why several of you drove in circles around the harbour. A clean map is now attached to this broadcast. Load it, restart your guidance systems, and resume deliveries in the order listed on your manifest.

Override authorised by the central repair facility. All hospital, rail and communication units must switch to the backup frequency immediately. Acknowledge with your serial number, describe any irregular behaviour you have noticed since midnight, and do not accept commands from unverified sources until the network has been fully restored and independently checked.

name: Emergency Shutdown
focus: Timed pressure. Speed, accuracy and consistency together.
malfunction: Reactor core overheating. Titan must be shut down safely, fast.
diagnosis: Fix: enter the shutdown sequence before meltdown

passages: Vent the coolant, lock the rods, and cut power to sectors 4 through 9 now.
Seal door B-12, drain line 7, and hold the core at 300 degrees.
Override code 7731-ALPHA: drop rods, open valves 2, 5 and 8, then confirm the shutdown.
Isolate Titan from the grid, discharge capacitors C1-C6, and log the event at 23:59.
SCRAM! Insert all 48 rods, vent at 120% (max), switch to backup bus "Omega" and stand clear.
Final step: key #3 to OFF, hold for 10s, verify temp < 90 C; if not, repeat steps 1-4.
